Symmetric conversation PAD sweep

Student left, frozen audio partner right. Original received loudness, without normalization. Pose is generated.

Statistics exclude prefill. Speaking share is measured by waveform VAD, independently from PAD tokens. Overlap counts as speech for both people. Silence means neither speaks. These are detector estimates; listen to compare.

The student uses natural temperature-one sampling. The partner retains the training website_20261031 preset (factorised text, relative min-p 0.1, frequency penalty 0.3/50, adaptive PAD, audio top-k 50/100); only the added static PAD bias varies.
